patterns.note: Full-width sections with a deep dark blue background, containing content centered within a constrained maximum width.
High-contrast dark theme using a deep dark blue as the primary background, white for main text, and a vibrant red for accents, CTAs, and key iconography.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up and slide-in animation as they enter the viewport during scroll, while the main navigation remains sticky at the top.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, paired with a clear, readable sans-serif for body text, all on a dark background.
Alternating shades of dark blue are used for background colors to visually separate distinct content blocks within the page.

technique_notes: The header navigation is implemented as a sticky element that remains fixed at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll.

Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, where elements fade in and slide up from the bottom as they become visible in the viewport, leveraging CSS keyframes for smooth transitions.
A subtle parallax effect is applied to the hero illustration, causing it to scroll at a slightly slower rate than the foreground text, adding depth to the initial view.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, regular weight body text and occasional small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and content cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between major sections, balanced spacing within content blocks.

standout: The distinctive use of a deep, dark blue background paired with a vibrant, almost neon red accent color creates a bold and modern aesthetic. The clean, flat illustrations and clear, concise messaging reinforce a professional yet approachable tech brand identity, especially effective for communicating a significant brand migration.
